test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
J, K, P, Q, R and M are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

J is sitting to the immediate left of M. R is sitting 2nd to the left of J. K is sitting 3rd to the right of J. P sits to the immediate right of R.

Who sits 2nd to the left of K?
solution:
**Given :** J, K, P, Q, R and M are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

**Explanation :**

1) J is sitting to the immediate left of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0de43dbee79b1bd6a0a4d622f5f382dc97bdaa399ebd2150f4a6898621295444.png] 

2) R is sitting 2nd to the left of J.

3) P sits to the immediate right of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8a56bb285652f2bafaa73fe6b78bf0fb15aac2ae36bfa06c5099b13bdc6cbee.png] 

4) K is sitting 3rd to the right of J.

After positioning K only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82ce03cbc652e1c097c57fc34bfb5b6c7c162030ba2046f6eb80e546aeea4991.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement M sits 2nd to the left of K.

Hence, **"M"** is the correct answer.
